what: The plan preserves the existing branch-protection guard but its allowed postbump STATUS list excludes branch-protected
scenario_or_breakage: An implementer can keep returning result.status=branch-protected from the guard, violating the stated bash STATUS-only contract and failing the new parity/status-vocabulary tests
suggested_fix: Map protected-branch refusal to an allowed bash STATUS such as branch-mismatch and put the protected-branch detail in detail or auxiliary fields
